description: Every field has its own language. key_points: light-year: distance light travels in one year (9.46e15 m)
magnitude: brightness scale, smaller is brighter
habitable zone: orbital band where liquid water is possible
redshift: cosmic expansion stretching light
parsec: 3.26 light-years, the professional distance unit
